headline: Bourse. Impact prepares a land-mortgage-guaranteed bond issue, which it presents as a first for the local market, with proceeds directed to the 501 million euro Aria Verdi project
summary: Impact Developer & Contractor has started procedures for a bond issue guaranteed by a land mortgage, which it presents as a first for the local market. Proceeds will go to the €501 million Aria Verdi project.
why: Impact is a Bucharest-listed real estate developer, and its bond issues show how local developers raise debt to fund large projects.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: Bursă. Impact pregăteşte o emisiune de obligaţiuni garantată cu ipotecă pe teren, pe care o prezintă drept o premieră pentru piaţa locală, cu banii direcţionaţi către proiectul Aria Verdi de 501 milioane de euro
